notes.title: Zombie Tower Survivor – Demo Update for Debut Festival 2025
notes.content:
Zombie Tower Survivor is featured in Debut Festival 2025! 🎉



We’ve released a demo update to celebrate, with new content, quality-of-life improvements, and balance tweaks.


What’s new in the demo v0.4.1.0:
Game settings menu, including fullscreen/windowed toggle and more

Custom spawn speed to control how fast enemies appear (replaced the option for adjusting game speed)

New Aspect: Hippo

Tutorial part 1 for new players (someone cute and fluffy will be there to help 😉)

DoT & Penetration talent rebalance

Tower level preview in shop

Real-time updates of stats

Bug fixes, such as infinite rerolls in the shop and achievements not saving correctly

...and other under-the-hood improvements
Try out the updated demo: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3476900/Zombie_Tower_Survivor_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
If you enjoy Zombie Tower Survivor, please leave a review and wishlist the game! It helps a ton. 🧟

notes.title: Demo is here! Play Zombie Tower Survivor now!
notes.content:
The demo for Zombie Tower Survivor is now live on Steam as part of the Zombies vs Vampires Fest 2025!

Step into a tower-defense roguelite where you fend off endless waves of zombies using customizable builds with powerful talents and upgrades.

Download the Demo

[previewyoutube=SipNrmK0xPA;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s new in the Steam demo?

If you played the early version on itch.io, this updated demo brings new content and improvements:

- Achievements that unlock new upgrades and talents
- Progression system – unlock new aspects by beating difficulties
- Gamepad and Steam Deck support
- Multi-upgrades & multi-talents for deeper build variety
- Talent rewards for leveling up your tower and abilities
- New Archmage Aspect
- Major balance improvements
- New custom cursor and more

Coming soon to the demo:

- Tutorial for new players
- Additional language support

Leave a review for the demo on Steam. Or drop by the Community Hub or join Discord to share feedback!

And don’t forget to wishlist the game on the main page if you enjoy it!
